page_text_ocr_zh:
借刀杀人

王汉

田单

公孙衍
page_text_en:
Kill with a borrowed knife

Wang Han

Tian Dan

Gongsun Yan
summary_zh: 本页标题为“借刀杀人”，画面中三位古代武将形象的人物并排站立，分别标注为王汉、田单和公孙衍，暗示该页将讲述与这三人相关的“借刀杀人”计谋故事。

page_text_ocr_zh: 春秋时期，齐景公手下有三位将军，他们分别是田开疆、古治子、公孙捷，号称"齐国三杰"。因为他们的功劳大，齐景公还给他们封了爵位。
page_text_en: In the Spring and Autumn period, King Jing of Qi had three generals under his command: Tian Kaijiang, Gu Zhizi, and Gongsun Jie, known as the "Three Heroes of Qi." Because of their great merits, King Jing of Qi also granted them noble titles.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了春秋时期齐景公手下的三位将军——田开疆、古治子和公孙捷，他们被称为“齐国三杰”，因功勋卓著而被封爵。

page_text_ocr_zh:
田开疆长了一张大红脸，眼睛大得像铜铃，鼻子像老鹰的嘴巴一样，又长又尖。
齐国攻打徐国的时候，田开疆是主帅。他战无不胜，斩杀了徐国的大将，抓住了五百多名徐国的士兵，吓得徐国和邻近的郑国、莒国都与齐国结了盟。
page_text_en:
Tian Kaijiang had a big red face, eyes as big as bronze bells, and a nose like an eagle's beak—long and sharp.
When Qi attacked Xu, Tian Kaijiang was the commander. He was invincible in battle, killed Xu's general, captured over five hundred soldiers from Xu, and frightened Xu and its neighboring states, Zheng and Ju, into forming alliances with Qi.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了齐国将军田开疆的外貌特征及其在攻打徐国时的英勇战绩，他作为主帅大获全胜，迫使徐国及邻国与齐国结盟。

page_text_ocr_zh:
没过多久，他就左手拎着马尾，右手提着大鼋的头，从水里跳了出来。
古冶子的脸黑得像是涂了一层墨汁，长着一把大胡子。他的两只手好像铜做的钩子，力大无比。有一次，他跟随齐景公渡黄河，忽然从水下钻出一只大鼋，一口咬住拉车的马，把它拖到了河中央。古冶子拔出宝剑，嗖的一下跳下水。
page_text_en:
Not long after, he emerged from the water, holding the horse's tail in his left hand and the head of the giant turtle in his right.
Gu Yizi's face was as black as if painted with ink, and he had a thick beard. His hands were like copper hooks, immensely strong. Once, while accompanying King Jing of Qi across the Yellow River, a giant turtle suddenly emerged from underwater, bit the horse pulling the carriage, and dragged it to the center of the river. Gu Yizi drew his sword and plunged into the water with a swift 'whoosh'.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了齐国将军古冶子勇斗黄河大鼋的场景，文字介绍了他力大无穷的特征及跳入水中斩杀大鼋的英勇事迹。

page_text_ocr_zh:
公孙捷的脸黑中透着紫，长着一双三角眼，虎背熊腰，体壮如牛，双手能举千斤重。
他跟着齐景公打猎时，半路上忽然跳出一只大老虎，一阵风似的向齐景公扑过来。文武百官都吓得躲开了，只有公孙捷挥舞双拳挡住了大老虎。他左手揪住老虎的脖子，右手砸向老虎的头，活活把老虎打死了。
page_text_en:
Gongsun Jie's face was dark with a purple tinge, with sharp triangular eyes, a broad back and thick waist, strong as an ox, and capable of lifting a thousand jin with both hands.
While hunting with King Jing of Qi, a huge tiger suddenly jumped out halfway, rushing toward King Jing like a gust of wind. The civil and military officials were all frightened and fled, but only Gongsun Jie swung his fists to block the tiger. He grabbed the tiger's neck with his left hand and smashed its head with his right, killing it outright.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了齐国三杰之一的公孙捷，描述了他勇猛的外貌特征，并讲述了他在陪同齐景公打猎时，徒手击毙猛虎的英勇事迹。

page_text_ocr_zh:
他们没读过多少书，仗着自己功劳大，见到丞相晏婴也不行礼，文武百官没有一个敢得罪他们。他们还常带着刀剑上朝，连齐景公见了也吓得心惊胆战。
田开疆、古冶子、公孙捷三人都喜欢练武功，志趣相投，就结拜成了兄弟。
page_text_en:
They hadn't read much, and relying on their great merits, they didn't bow to Chancellor Yan Ying, and no official dared to offend them. They often carried swords and knives to court, even making King Jing of Qi tremble with fear.
Tian Kaijiang, Gu Yizi, and Gongsun Jie all liked practicing martial arts, shared similar interests, and thus became sworn brothers.
summary_zh: 本页描述了齐国三杰田开疆、古冶子、公孙捷因功高自傲、目中无人，连丞相晏婴和齐景公都惧怕他们，三人志趣相投，结为兄弟。

page_text_ocr_zh: 有一天，晏婴就对齐景公说："主公，他们三个人这么无礼，真是我们国家的祸害！"齐景公愁眉苦脸地说："唉，我也担心他们早晚要夺我的王位。可是他们武功高强，没人打得过呀！"晏婴说："这三个人都是头脑简单的武夫，也不懂长幼之礼，我略施小计，一定能除掉他们。"
page_text_en: One day, Yan Ying said to King Jing of Qi: "Your Majesty, these three men are so disrespectful; they are truly a disaster for our country!" King Jing frowned and said: "Alas, I'm also worried they will eventually seize my throne. But they are so skilled in martial arts; no one can defeat them!" Yan Ying replied: "These three are merely simple-minded warriors who don't understand the etiquette of seniority. With a little trick, I can surely get rid of them."
summary_zh: 晏婴向齐景公进言，指出齐国三杰因无礼且武功高强，可能威胁王权，他提出可通过计谋除掉他们。

page_text_ocr_zh: 不久，鲁昭公带着丞相叔孙婼来到齐国，想与齐国结盟。齐景公大设宴席招待他们，请晏婴主持，三位将军佩剑守护在阶下。酒过三巡，晏婴起身对齐景公说：‘御花园里的金桃成熟了，我去摘几个来，恭祝两位君主福寿安康！’
page_text_en: Soon, Duke Zhuang of Lu arrived in Qi with his prime minister, Shusun Nuo, intending to form an alliance with Qi. Duke Jing of Qi hosted a grand banquet for them, inviting Yan Ying to preside, while the three generals stood guard with swords at the steps. After three rounds of wine, Yan Ying rose and said to Duke Jing: 'The golden peaches in the imperial garden are ripe. I'll go pick a few to wish both of your majesties long life and good health!'
summary_zh: 鲁昭公与丞相叔孙婼来访齐国，齐景公设宴款待，晏婴主持，三位将军佩剑侍立。酒过三巡，晏婴以摘金桃为由，向齐景公请示，实为借机实施计谋。

page_text_ocr_zh:
不一会儿，晏婴就回来了，他带人端来了六个碗大的桃子。桃子火红火红的，隔得老远就能闻到一股香味。
齐景公骄傲地说："我这棵桃树来自海外仙山。桃树长了三十多年，枝繁叶茂，每年花开满树，可惜结的桃子却只有这么几个。"
page_text_en:
In a moment, Yan Ying returned, bringing six large peach-like fruits on trays. The peaches were bright red, and their fragrance could be smelled from afar.
King Jing of Qi proudly said: "This peach tree comes from a fairy mountain beyond the sea. It has grown for over thirty years, with lush branches and leaves, blooming full of flowers every year, yet sadly, it bears only a few fruits like these."
summary_zh: 晏婴带回六个巨大的桃子，齐景公骄傲地介绍这些桃子来自海外仙山，稀有珍贵，为后续分桃计谋做铺垫。

page_text_ocr_zh:
齐景公与鲁昭公、晏婴、叔孙婼各吃了一个桃子，盘子里还剩下两个。晏婴对齐景公说："主公，把这两个桃子赏赐给阶下的有功之臣吧！"

齐景公马上对站在阶下的三位将军说："好，你们自己说一说谁的功劳大，让丞相来分桃子吧。"
page_text_en:
King Jing of Qi, Duke Zhuang of Lu, Yan Ying, and Shu Sun Nuo each ate one peach. There were two left in the dish. Yan Ying said to King Jing: "Your Majesty, please grant these two peaches to the meritorious ministers below the steps!"

King Jing immediately turned to the three generals standing below the steps and said: "Very well, you yourselves tell me who has the greatest merit, and let the Prime Minister distribute the peaches accordingly."
summary_zh: 齐景公与鲁昭公、晏婴、叔孙婼各食一桃，盘中余二桃。晏婴建议将桃子赏赐给阶下有功之臣，齐景公遂命三位将军自述功劳，由丞相分桃。

page_text_ocr_zh:
性急的公孙捷听了，立马挺身上前说："当年我从猛虎爪下救出主公，这个功劳怎么样？"
"冒死救主，功比泰山，赐酒一杯，桃一个。"晏婴说。公孙捷立刻端起酒杯一饮而尽，接着拿起一个桃，站到一旁，十分得意。
page_text_en:
The impetuous Gongsun Jie, upon hearing this, immediately stood up and said, "When I rescued the sovereign from the claws of a fierce tiger, how great was that merit?"
"Risking life to save the sovereign, the merit is as great as Mount Tai. Grant a cup of wine and a peach," said Yan Ying. Gongsun Jie immediately raised his cup and drank it in one gulp, then took a peach and stood aside, feeling very proud.
summary_zh: 公孙捷自述救主功劳，晏婴赞其功比泰山，赐酒和桃，公孙捷得意地饮酒取桃。

page_text_ocr_zh: 古冶子也站出来说：‘打死一只老虎有什么稀奇！当年我跳进黄河中，杀死了大鼋，才保得主公安全，这个功劳岂不是更大？’齐景公说：‘要不是将军斩鼋除怪，我的命早就没了。这是盖世奇功，理应赐桃。’晏婴忙把剩下的一个桃子和一杯酒送给了古冶子。
page_text_en: Gu Yizi also stepped forward and said, 'What's so extraordinary about killing a tiger! When I jumped into the Yellow River and killed the giant turtle, I saved the lord's life—wasn't that a greater achievement?' The King of Qi said, 'If it weren't for the general slaying the turtle and eliminating the monster, my life would have been lost long ago. This is a world-renowned feat; he should certainly be granted a peach.' Yan Ying hurriedly gave the remaining peach and a cup of wine to Gu Yizi.
summary_zh: 古冶子自述跳入黄河斩杀大鼋、救主有功，齐景公称赞其功绩盖世，晏婴遂将最后一个桃子和一杯酒赐予他。

page_text_ocr_zh: 这时，田开疆也走了上来。他不慌不忙地说："我攻克徐国，让徐、郯、莒三国奉主公为盟主，这个功劳能吃一个桃子吗？"晏婴回答说："田将军为齐国开疆拓土，比公孙将军和古将军的功劳高出十倍也不止。可是桃子已经吃完了，您先喝一杯酒，等明年结了桃再给您一个。"
page_text_en: At this moment, Tian Kaijiang also stepped forward. He calmly said, "I conquered the State of Xu, causing the rulers of Xu, Tan, and Ju to pledge allegiance to our lord. Is this achievement not worthy of a peach?" Yan Ying replied, "General Tian, you have expanded the territory of Qi, your merit surpasses that of Generals Gongsun and Gu by tenfold. But the peaches are already gone. Please drink a cup of wine first, and I will give you one next year when the peaches ripen."
summary_zh: 田开疆自述攻克徐国、使三国归附的功绩，要求分得一个桃子，但晏婴以桃子已分完为由，只赐酒并承诺来年再给，田开疆因此感到不公而愤怒。

page_text_ocr_zh: 田开疆手按剑柄，生气地说：‘打虎、杀鼋有什么了不起！我南征北战，出生入死，反而吃不到桃子，还在两位国君面前受到这样的羞辱，我还有什么脸面站在朝堂之上呢？’说完，他竟然拔出宝剑，当场自刎了。
page_text_en: Tian Kaijiang placed his hand on the hilt of his sword and angrily said, 'What's so great about killing a tiger or a giant turtle! I have fought battles far and wide, risking my life, yet I can't even get a peach. I am humiliated before two kings—how can I possibly face the court? After saying this, he drew his sword and committed suicide on the spot.
summary_zh: 田开疆因未分得桃子而感到羞辱，愤然拔剑自刎。

page_text_ocr_zh:
公孙捷大吃一惊，拔出剑来，说道："我因小功而吃桃，田将军功劳大反而吃不到桃。我不知谦让，又没能救下田将军，还有什么脸面活在世上？"说完也自杀了。
古冶子更沉不住气了，大喊道："当年我们三人结为兄弟，亲如骨肉，发誓同生共死。如今他们俩都死了，我一个人活着，又怎么能心安？"说完，他也拔剑挥向了自己。
page_text_en:
Gongsun Jie was greatly shocked, drew his sword, and said: "I ate a peach for a minor achievement, while General Tian, who had greater merit, received none. I failed to show humility, and I couldn't even save General Tian. How can I face the world?" Then he killed himself.
Gu Yizi could no longer hold back, shouting: "Long ago, the three of us became brothers, as close as flesh and blood, swearing to live and die together. Now that the other two are dead, how can I live on in peace?" Then he also drew his sword and struck himself.
summary_zh: 公孙捷因自感功小却得桃而羞愧，自刎身亡；古冶子因兄弟同生共死的誓言，也拔剑自尽。

page_text_ocr_zh: 晏婴自己没有动手，却借着两个桃子，除掉了三位居功自傲的将军，这种计策就叫“借刀杀人”。
page_text_en: Yan Ying himself did not take action, but by using two peaches, he eliminated three generals who were arrogant about their merits. This strategy is called "borrowing a knife to kill someone."
summary_zh: 本页总结了晏婴通过分桃计策，借三位将军的自尊心使其自相残杀，最终除掉他们的故事，点明此计为“借刀杀人”。
